title: arxiv_2504.06357v1
universal_lens: A unified mathematical framework for soccer game state reconstruction integrating multi-modal sensor data, spatiotemporal tracking, and probabilistic role inference under dynamic camera constraints. The mapping from broadcast pixels to a canonical pitch manifold is formalized as a projective transformation operator. This unifies visual segmentation, keypoint detection, and geometric optimization into a single differentiable coordinate system, establishing an invariant state space for all subsequent kinematic tracking and tactical analysis.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian belief propagation over player trajectory manifolds with conformal predictive intervals for real-time tactical decision support in GSI analytics pipelines. GSI employs conformal Bayesian inference over the SegFormer-derived camera parameters. By treating pitch line intersections as noisy observations, we construct a posterior distribution over the homography matrix, providing rigorous uncertainty quantification for every projected athlete coordinate and mitigating broadcast occlusion errors.
gse_mapping: Situation-aware state transition graphs encoding player roles, team affiliations, and positional dynamics within a single-camera broadcast domain for GSE motion planning. Within GSE, the refined camera alignment acts as the foundational state-transition kernel. It maps raw pixel trajectories into a continuous spatial graph, enabling real-time situational reasoning, dynamic offside calculations, and precise measurement of passing lanes relative to the underlying pitch topology.

primitives.verbatim_quote: Achieving accurate GSR using a single-camera setup is highly challenging due to frequent camera movements, occlusions, and dynamic scene content.

primitives.name: End-to-End Pipeline Architecture
primitives.verbatim_quote: Our solution integrates a fine-tuned YOLOv5m for object detection, a SegFormerbased camera parameter estimator, and a DeepSORT-based tracking framework enhanced with re-identification, orientation prediction, and jersey number recognition.
primitives.assumptions: Each module operates independently but contributes to a shared latent space for joint optimization.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When any component fails to converge within 50ms processing latency.

primitives.name: Temporal Consistency Metric

primitives.assumptions: Trajectory continuity holds unless explicit occlusion occurs; temporal smoothing preserves motion coherence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When inter-frame displacement exceeds 3 meters without valid motion model.
